FAQ

Common questions

01

How do I register for a training?

+
Use the "Register" button on this page to select your session and complete registration and payment to reserve your spot.
02

Who leads the trainings?

+
All sessions are led by Gilberto Amador, M.Ed., Ed.S., and certified educators and executive consultants bringing over 35 years of supervisory, academic, and community leadership experience.
03

Can my organization partner with Mass2Miami?

+
Yes! We partner directly with schools, civic associations, nonprofits, and businesses across Massachusetts and Florida. Reach out to schedule a consultation on building learning labs or tailored workshops.
